what: The full-bleed photo panel moves to the next photo every 5.4 seconds (WebGL) — by the value of a circular mask that is 0 at the center and 1 at the edge, the old photo is swept toward the lower right (direction 1,1 · strength .5) and the next photo is swept in from the opposite side, blending over 1 second quart.out. The center changes in place and the edges are swept more. Without WebGL it crossfades over the same length

options.delay: Extra wait before the first turn (sec, e.g. loader length), default 0
options.ease: Easing curve in ”0.16,1,0.3,1” type or a GSAP name, default power3.out(= quart.out)
options.ratio: Height/width ratio for drawing the placeholder panel, default .625 (16:10)
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: A single photo (child) — inside Use as is, if absent, draw the panel from the background color and label of the inner .wf-img
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Surface the canvas is laid on (the element itself if none)
options.Event fx:mask-push-slides: Event detail.index from the element on every slide change

note: The original swapped in the transition step of Splide fade and drew it on a three canvas. The part runs at the same interval and length without Splide (the site copy is built directly on Splide 4.1.4). Instead of the original mask image, a circular gradient of the same shape is drawn on canvas
